Wow. I don't think I will be able to review this very well (and I kind of doubt anyone else will either). All I can say is that looking at the new TOC layout, this seems like a big improvement. I can see how this is a much better setup, and will probably help with things like https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/1643.

What do you think about nesting the picture/source/img sections under the "Images" section, probably after "Introduction"? I kind of like the pattern we see elsewhere in the spec of the introduction preceding the API definitions.

Otherwise, LGTM.

It would have been a better structure but all elements in the spec have the same heading level, so this structure is used in other places as well (e.g. media elements). Possibly there are some scripts that assume elements have this heading level also...
Ah OK, that's understandable. Merge at will, then!
